name: Kissing
overview: Scripture portrays kissing as a meaningful expression that can signify affection, trust, and sincerity, as seen in Ruth's farewell kiss and the proverb highlighting the value of truthful words. It also uses kissing metaphorically to describe the union of mercy and truth or to warn against deceitful affection, emphasizing discernment in relationships. The call to 'Kiss the Son' in Psalms underscores reverence and devotion to Christ. While the Bible records instances of affectionate kisses, it also implicitly guides believers to approach physical expressions like kissing, including those related to youth and premarital contexts, with wisdom and godly discernment.
